violation_type.title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Hand-washing Sink (26 TAC §746.2405(4))
violation_type.short_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment - Hand-washing Sink
violation_type.typical_finding: No handwashing sinks were observed in rooms where diaper change will be happening.

finding_variants.text: No handwashing sinks were observed in rooms where diaper change will be happening.
The handwashing sink in one of the infant rooms was out of order, and the portable handwashing sink in another infant room had been moved out of the room.
The infant space did not have a handwashing sink.
The two rooms that will be designated for infants (0-17 months) do not have sinks.
The infant room did not have a sink installed.
There is no sink next to the diaper changing station.
